tests.name: Complete Blood Count (CBC) with ESR
tests.preparationInstructions: No fasting required. Maintain normal hydration before blood draw.
tests.description: Evaluates Hemoglobin, WBC/TLC, DLC, Platelets, and ESR to screen anemia and infection.

tests.name: Glycated Hemoglobin (HbA1c)
tests.preparationInstructions: No fasting strictly required; sample can be drawn anytime.
tests.description: Measures average blood glucose control over the preceding 90–120 days.

tests.name: Lipid Profile (Cardiovascular Panel)
tests.preparationInstructions: Requires 10–12 hours overnight water-only fasting prior to sample collection.
tests.description: Measures Total Cholesterol, Triglycerides, HDL, LDL, and VLDL ratios.
tests.commonNormalRange: Total Chol: <200 mg/dL; TG: <150 mg/dL; LDL: <100 mg/dL; HDL: >40 mg/dL

tests.name: Liver Function Tests (LFTs)
tests.preparationInstructions: 8 hours overnight fasting recommended for baseline enzyme clarity.
tests.description: Measures Total Bilirubin, ALT (SGPT), AST (SGOT), Alkaline Phosphatase, and Albumin.
tests.commonNormalRange: Bilirubin: 0.2–1.2 mg/dL; ALT: 7–56 U/L; ALP: 44–147 U/L

tests.name: Renal / Kidney Function Tests (RFT)
tests.preparationInstructions: No fasting required. Avoid heavy exercise 24h before collection.
tests.description: Assesses Serum Creatinine, Blood Urea, BUN, and estimated GFR.

tests.name: Thyroid Function Panel (Free T3, Free T4, TSH)
tests.preparationInstructions: No fasting required. Take Thyroxine tablets after sample draw unless directed otherwise.
tests.description: Measures TSH, Free T4, and Free T3 to evaluate thyroid endocrine function.

tests.name: Vitamin D (25-OH Total)
tests.description: Measures 25-hydroxy Vitamin D levels for bone health and immune support.

tests.name: Dengue NS1 Antigen (Rapid / ELISA)
tests.preparationInstructions: No fasting required. Optimal Day 1–5 of fever onset.
tests.description: Detects acute Dengue virus NS1 antigenemia.
